improvements.yes_no_contract: Determinable MISRA yes/no questions start with Yes. or No. before the grounded explanation. Classification-choice questions remain non-binary.
improvements.bare_rule_family_clarification: A bare major identifier such as Rule 17 is resolved to its indexed 17.x family and asks the user for an exact child Rule instead of a generic fallback.
improvements.rationale_cross_reference_sources: When a Rule rationale explicitly defers to an exact Section, both the Rule and followed Section remain visible as supporting sources.
improvements.single_item_structured_list_format: One-item structured list answers preserve heading, scope note, and bullet layout instead of being flattened into malformed bullets.
improvements.comparison_wording: Comparison difference wording is less repetitive while preserving the exact authoritative Rule statements.
improvements.quiet_apply_output: Normal apply/validation output uses concise PASS/INFO messages. True blocking conditions still stop safely with one concise FAIL.
